name: amiyo-browser
description: AMIYO Browser - Modern, fast, and secure desktop web browser built with Electron and Chromium

scripts.test:e2e: node -e "const cp = require('child_process'); const env = {...process.env}; delete env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; const child = cp.spawn(require('electron'), ['--no-sandbox', '--disable-gpu', 'tests/e2e-verification.js'], { env, stdio: 'inherit' }); child.on('exit', (c) => process.exit(c));"

author: AMIYO
